svg.title: Frame profiler panels (proposal)
svg.desc: Left: the editor with the Profiler tab open in the bottom dock, streaming from a running game over the editor link: a toolbar of icon buttons (source, record, pause, clear, GPU timings, spike threshold, save and open trace, one tooltip shown), a frame-time graph with 16.7 and 33.3 ms budget lines, a red spike and the selected frame, a timeline of the selected frame with Main, Loader, Audio and GPU lanes of nested scopes, a scope table and a counters list. Right: the in-game F12 dev overlay with its Profiler section expanded: pause, spike threshold and save buttons, a small frame graph, CPU, GPU and wait times, the top CPU and GPU scopes as bars, and a counters line.
svg.text: Profiler tab (proposal); Animation tab from G1.6
bars: CPU frame ms · line: GPU ms · click a bar to select
ms, averaged over the selected frames · click a header to sort
Left: the editor's Profiler tab in the bottom dock, fed by the running game over the editor link. Right: the Profiler section of the
in-game F12 dev overlay (504 dp column, shown narrower). Lane colours: script blue, physics green, render purple, UI amber, audio/loading teal, GPU pink.
